name: Adrenal gland
description: Small glands above the kidneys.

name: Bile ducts
description: Channels carrying bile from the liver toward the intestine.

name: Bone
description: Skeletal tissue; a leg is used as a representative location.

name: Brain/CNS
description: Brain and central nervous system; brain regions and spinal cord are grouped together.

name: Breast
description: Breast tissue on the anterior chest wall.

name: Cervix
description: Lower part of the uterus; shown as a separate clinical anatomical site. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Colon
description: Large intestine; shown separately from the rectum.

name: Esophagus
description: Food passage through the neck and chest to the stomach.

name: Eye
description: Eye; uveal melanoma cohorts contribute this site.

name: Fallopian tube
description: Tubes extending from the uterus toward the ovaries. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Heart
description: Heart; multiple sampled regions count as one organ group.

name: Kidney
description: Kidney; cortex and other sampled subregions are merged.

name: Liver
description: Liver; includes primary hepatic disease and liver specimens from metastatic disease.

name: Lung
description: Lung; different lung-cancer subtypes do not add separate organs.

name: Lymph nodes
description: Lymphatic tissue. A neck node is illustrated; CAMELYON and PCAM contain lymph-node specimens.

name: Ovary
description: Ovarian tissue, including ovarian-cancer cohorts. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Pancreas
description: Gland extending across the upper abdomen.

name: Pituitary gland
description: Small endocrine gland at the base of the brain; position is schematic.

name: Prostate
description: Gland below the bladder in male pelvic anatomy. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Rectum
description: Distal large intestine; counted separately from colon as a clinical site.

name: Salivary glands
description: Salivary gland tissue; individual glands are merged into one group.

name: Skin
description: Distributed over the body; the arm indicates a representative skin site.

name: Small intestine
description: Small bowel; sampled segments are merged into one group.

name: Spleen
description: Lymphatic organ in the left upper abdomen.

name: Stomach
description: Stomach; gastric-cancer labels map to this site.

name: Testis
description: Testicular tissue; separate from the prostate. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Thymus
description: Lymphatic organ in the upper chest.

name: Thyroid gland
description: Endocrine gland in the neck.

name: Urinary bladder
description: Urinary bladder; not the same site as kidney or prostate.

name: Uterus (corpus)
description: Body of the uterus; cervix is shown separately as a clinical site. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Vagina
description: Vaginal tissue in female pelvic anatomy. This site is not depicted in the overview illustration.

name: Adipose tissue
description: Fat tissue distributed across the body; GTEx sampling sites are merged.

name: Blood
description: Circulating blood and blood-clot specimens; a stroke indication does not make a clot a brain specimen.

name: Blood vessels
description: Vascular tissue; arterial sampling beds are merged.

name: Bone marrow
description: Hematopoietic tissue within bones; listed separately from bone and circulating blood.

name: Mesothelium (pleura/peritoneum)
description: Tissue lining the chest and abdominal cavities.

name: Peripheral nerve
description: Nerve tissue outside the brain and spinal cord.

name: Skeletal muscle
description: Voluntary muscle tissue distributed across the skeleton.
